questions.prompt: What does pi put in the prompt for each skill?
options: The name, the description and the file path
The first 60 characters of the file
questions.explanation: Only the name, description and path sit in the prompt. The model reads the full SKILL.md when the task matches.

questions.prompt: An expert has only domain tools and no read or bash tool. What happens to its skills?
options: pi shows an error at start
The skills section is left out, so the skills are silently lost
pi adds the read tool by itself
questions.explanation: The skills section appears only if the read or bash tool is available, because the model needs one of them to open the file.

questions.prompt: A SKILL.md has a name but no description. What does pi do?
options: It loads the skill and uses the name as the description
It does not load the skill
It uses the first line of the steps
It loads the skill only for /skill:name
questions.explanation: The description is required. Without one, the skill is not loaded.
